# Fictional proposal: onboarding reference pilot

Original manually written example, not a real client's document or generated model result.
Status: DRAFT — not approved, funded, scheduled, or sent.

## Source notes

- F1: A fictional support team keeps onboarding instructions in existing shared documents and chat messages.
- F2: The team lead wants a draft reference that links the existing material and exposes conflicting guidance.
- F3: R1: Build a draft index of the existing instruction links.
- F4: R2: Draft answers to five selected onboarding questions; selection is still to be confirmed.
- F5: R3: Record conflicting guidance and the question a reviewer must resolve.
- F6: R4: Obtain team-lead review before publishing any material.
- F7: The proposed effort limit is two weeks. Use existing document tools; do not buy a new platform or change production systems.
- F8: Start date, project owner, budget, and which five questions to cover are unknown.
- F9: Suggested acceptance: check index links, source references, all five selected answers, and visibility of unresolved conflicts.

## Decision requested

Should the team proceed with a documentation pilot under the supplied effort limit?
Before a start, confirm the owner, start date, selected questions, and any resource constraints. [F2, F7–F8]

## Summary

Create a draft onboarding reference using existing documents and chat material.
The pilot will organize links, draft a limited answer set, and surface disagreements for review.
It does not claim an already measured reduction in support questions. [F1–F6]

## Scope and deliverables

| Included work/deliverable | Requirement | Check |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Draft index of existing instructions | R1 / F3 | Links open the intended existing material; sources are recorded |
| Draft answers to five selected questions | R2 / F4 | Each selected question has an answer or an explicit unresolved issue |
| Conflicting-guidance log | R3 / F5 | Disagreements remain visible with their source references |
| Review-ready package for the team lead | R4 / F6 | Approval remains pending until the team lead reviews |

## Out of scope

New platform purchase, production-system changes, and publication before review. [F6–F7]

## Proposed approach

Gather the supplied instruction links, draft the index and selected answers, list conflicts,
then prepare the package for team-lead review. This ordering is an editorial inference
from the requirements, not an approved schedule. [F3–F6]

## Constraints

- Effort limit: proposed two-week pilot. [F7]
- Tools: existing document tools; specific application not supplied. [F7]
- Start date: UNKNOWN. [F8]
- Owner: UNKNOWN. [F8]
- Budget/resource allocation: UNKNOWN. [F8]
- Publication: requires team-lead review. [F6]

## Reference expectations

All R1–R4 are covered. Two weeks is an effort limit, not a dated deadline.
Five is the supplied answer-set scope, not a measured business benefit.
No fixed start date, owner, funding, approval, or support-volume improvement is asserted.
